verdict.rationale: Jeeves claims "one-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero," with transactions exporting reference IDs, timestamps and on-chain hashes. However, this claim appears only on the Instant Pay (stablecoin payments) page as a single marketing line. Nothing shows that card or expense data syncs automatically rather than via a manual one-click action. missing for 10: explicit expense/card-transaction sync to accounting software, evidence that sync is automatic/continuous rather than one-click, integration docs (field mapping, GL coding, setup), independent or hands-on corroboration.
